## What's new

- Keeps the LCD ring animation from gradually slowing during live updates.
- Updates the app to **Disconnected** when the LCD is unplugged.

Download the Windows ZIP, extract it, and double-click `run_app.vbs`. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/DeDaMrAzR/HAF700_EVO_Iris_LCD_control#installation) if this is your first install.
